stem.en: Which statement best describes a gurukula in early India?

text.en: A day school where pupils came each morning and went home each evening.
A place where only the Vedas were studied and no other skills were taught.
An army camp where young men trained only in archery and wrestling.
The teacher's home was its centre, and students lived there as members of the family.

explanation.en: The teacher's home served as the centre of the gurukula, and a student was treated as a member of the teacher's family. Students lived there, so it was not a day school. They studied many subjects alongside the Vedas, and archery was one skill among many.

hints.en: Where did the students sleep and eat?
